SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DAO_LONG_EVENT.title: Daolon Wong's Dark Chi
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DAO_LONG_EVENT.pages.INI:
In a dark alley, you meet a white-haired sorcerer wrapped in black robes. Sickly green light coils around the tip of his staff: pure *dark chi*.

Daolon Wong sneers at your followers. "Shendu, your servants are pathetic. Chow, Ratso, Finn... they fail you again and again. I can grant them true power."

He raises his staff. The air turns cold and heavy, and an irresistible will locks onto the servant cards in your deck.
Transform all *Dark Hand · Chow*, *Dark Hand · Ratso*, *Dark Hand · Finn*, and *Mount Tai Press* into *Gan*, *Wen*, *Cui*, and *Mountain*.
Even Valmont bothered to remember our names. Would it kill you to remember them too?
There is no available Act 1 Elite encounter in this run.
Daolon Wong's dark chi has already locked onto your heart.
Your deck has no *Dark Hand · Chow*, *Dark Hand · Ratso*, *Dark Hand · Finn*, or *Mount Tai Press*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DAO_LONG_EVENT.pages.ACC:
Green light bursts from the staff.

"Gan! Wen! Cui! Mountain! Go, and serve me!"

With a painful roar, the ordinary faces in your deck twist and reshape into savage *Dark Warriors*. Dark chi flows around them. They have been remade.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DAO_LONG_EVENT.pages.NO_:
Daolon Wong glances at your side and snorts with contempt.

"No servants at all? Has the mighty Fire Demon fallen so low that he must charge into battle himself? What a waste of my time."

The sorcerer flickers away, dissolving into a wisp of smoke deep in the alley.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DAO_LONG_EVENT.pages.AFT:
The echoes of battle fade, leaving only scorch marks where dark chi burned through the alley.

Daolon Wong's expression darkens. He does not press the matter further; he only strikes the ground with his staff and lets you step away from the mess.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DAO_LONG_EVENT.pages.NO_:
Daolon Wong raises his staff, but the dark chi thins into smoke before it can take shape.

No Act 1 Elite answers the call here. After a moment of silence, he waves you away in irritation.
Dark chi coils through the alley for a moment, but finds no true target.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DAO_LONG_EVENT.pages.LEF: You leave the alley steeped in dark chi.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ROB_TALISMAN_EVENT.title: Talisman Theft
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ROB_TALISMAN_EVENT.pages:
*Good chi* and *dark chi* exist in a dangerous balance. When one side grows too strong, the other rises to match it.

With every talisman absorbed, the *dark chi* inside Shendu surges. In answer, the *good chi* scattered throughout the world gathers as well. Whoever comes for you now will be stronger than before.

You feel an unprecedented *sense of crisis*.
Requires at least *1* *Fake Talisman* in your deck.
Take *10* damage. Gain *2* random current-game Curses.
Enter an empowered *Elite combat*. Starting Elites gain *Talisman Raid*. Resolve normal Elite rewards afterward.

*"Ay-yah! A blessing in disguise!"*

You quickly shove a *Fake Talisman* into your pursuer's hand. While the poor fool is still staring at the "stone," you have already vanished into the end of the alley.

*Uncle*: "One more thing! Stop making fake things! Tricking old people is not nice!"

You happen to be in a crowded street, so you fling your gold into the air. Screams, shouts, and hurried footsteps swallow the alley.

By the time your pursuer looks up from the glittering chaos, you have already disappeared into the crowd.

The instant your pursuer strikes, you feel a hollow ache in your chest.

A precious *Talisman* is torn away, and your power weakens with it. The good chi fades, leaving only the silence of spent talisman heat.

You grit your teeth and let the spell crash into your body.

The talismans remain yours, but pain burns through scale and bone. The lingering good chi sinks into your deck like thorns, becoming new curses.

You ready yourself for battle, but the area falls strangely quiet.

No suitable Elite answers your challenge. Awkward, yes, but your talismans are still yours for now.
Good chi and dark chi clash briefly in the empty alley, but neither finds a true target.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SAFE_AREA13_EVENT.title: The "Safest" Area 13
*Uncle*: "Ay-yah! One more thing! Jackie, Captain Black, look carefully! That demon Shendu actually brought the Dark Hand and looted Area 13's vault dry! Jackie, go after him now. Uncle will read the loss list first!"

You stand among overturned shelves and flashing alarms, with sealed crates rolling at your feet. Since you have already seized everything, how do you split the loot?
Seize Talisman
Gain *1* missing Talisman and *1* random base-game Potion.
All Talismans Collected
Area 13 has no Talisman you have not taken already.
Raid Mask Vault
Gain *1* missing Mask, Potion slots *+2*, and *1* random base-game Potion.
All Masks Collected
Area 13's mask archive has already been emptied.
Emergency Supply
Gain *8* Max HP.
Loot the Vault
Gain *2* random non-Boss base-game Relics.
Leave
Leave Area 13 before the alarms get worse.

You pull a still-warm talisman from the bottom of a crate and snatch one base-game potion on the way.

Uncle stomps in anger from afar: "Ay-yah! Shendu, you did not even read the potion label!"

You kick open the sealed cabinet, take one missing mask blueprint, force your potion belt to open two extra slots, then stuff in one base-game potion.

*Uncle*: "Ay-yah! That is tampering with evidence!"

There is plenty of core loot to steal, but the emergency supply crates are not just decoration. A few field injections later, your body feels sturdier.

Gain *8* Max HP.

You sweep the remaining base-game relic racks clean and carry away two random base-game relics.

*Uncle*: "Ay-yah! You will not even spare the backup vault!"

The alarms are getting closer. You glance at the scattered seals and decide not to waste more time here.

Area 13 is still very safe, just not for everyone else.
The alarms echo through the empty vault, but this time nobody is here to carry the loot away.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGO_EVENT.title: Drago
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGO_EVENT.loss: After refusing Uncle's cooperation, Drago ruled the world...
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGO_EVENT.pages.INITIA:
*"Ay-yah!!!"* You see an old man in a yellow shirt glaring at you, with a helpless-looking Jackie standing nearby.
*Uncle*: "Shendu! Your son Drago has collected the eight demons, and he's going to turn Earth into a lava hell!"
*Jackie*: "Shendu, although we were enemies before, now... we need your power. To stop Drago, we must cooperate."
I am proud of my son Drago. *The price is unbearable*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGO_EVENT.pages.CONFIR: *Uncle*: "Ay-yah! How much longer are you going to think? Are you waiting for Drago to burn off your tail too? Hurry up!"
Perhaps Jackie and the others are right...
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGO_EVENT.pages.ACCEPT:
*Uncle*: "Good! Tohru, imbue the *Chi Magic* onto Shendu! *Yu Mo Gui Gwai Fai Di Zao, Yu Mo Gui Gwai Fai Di Zao*..."

Following Uncle's chant, you feel the dark chi in your body balanced by a gentle good chi. Though this *makes you feel a bit uncomfortable*, you have indeed established a mysterious connection with this "J-Team."
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGO_EVENT.pages.DEAD.d:
*"I am proud of my son Drago!"*

You sneer and push Uncle away. As a Fire Demon, you would rather see the world destroyed than bow your head to these mortals.

Uncle sighs: *"Ay-yah... I knew it. Jackie, stay away from this stubborn statue."*

Following your refusal, the roar of Drago destroying the world echoes from afar. Lava instantly swallows the temple, and you feel the life force in your body rapidly draining...
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGO_EVENT.pages.NO_OWN: The fire flickers over empty ground and fades.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX_EVENT.title: 远古的封印
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX_EVENT.pages.I:
在高塔深处一个布满尘埃的隐蔽祭坛上，你发现了一个奇特的 *机关石匣* 。它由未知的古老材质打造，表面布满了精密咬合的齿轮与八个神秘的 *卦象符号* 。

*石匣* 发出了低沉的嗡鸣。一段不属于你的古老记忆涌入脑海：在远古时代，八位 *不朽的神明* 曾联手铸造了这件名为 *“潘库宝盒”* 的法器，将统治大地的 *八大恶魔* 逐一放逐至无尽的 *深渊* 。

*封印* 是枷锁，却也是唯一能开启 *恶魔之门* 的钥匙。此刻，它正随着你的心跳闪烁着微光，似乎在渴求某种 *代价* 来重新启动它内部的远古齿轮……
失去 *10* 点最大生命上限，获得遗物：*潘库宝盒*。
你的最大生命值不足 *10* 点。
随机获得 *1* 张当前游戏诅咒，获得遗物：*潘库宝盒*。
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX_EVENT.pages.P:
你将 *血液* 滴在宝盒的缝隙中。随着机括转动的咔嗒声，齿轮开始自行运转，*卦象符号* 依次亮起。

*潘库宝盒* 悬浮在你的身旁，你隐约听到了远方传来的、令人毛骨悚然的 *恶魔低语* 。地图上似乎有几个特定的地方，正在呼唤着你……
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX_EVENT.pages.G:
你没有理会神明的警告，强行掰开了宝盒的一角。一股刺骨的 *寒意* 顺着指尖钻入你的心智，但同时，宝盒也认可了你的 *野心* 。

*恶魔的门扉* 已向你敞开，但内心的阴霾却久久挥之不去。
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX_EVENT.pages.L: 传说中的力量往往伴随着 *万劫不复* 的深渊。你明智地收回了手，将这个 *危险的魔盒* 永远留在了高塔的尘埃里。
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX_EVENT.pages.N: 远古齿轮短暂转动了一下，却没有找到真正的持有者。
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHIVA_BRACELET_EVENT.pag:
Dust from an archaeological dig hangs over the *desolate ruins of an Indian temple*, mixed with a *dangerous pulse of magic*.

"Bad day, bad day, bad day! How did *Ah Fu* follow me all the way here?!" *Jackie* clutches a *box* taken from deep within the temple and runs between broken pillars and fallen stone.

"Black Tiger sweeps over Vulture! Hand over the *Bracelets of Shiva*!"
With his trademark roar, the red-haired Dark Hand bruiser *Ah Fu* drops from above and smashes a pillar beside *Jackie*. Both are chasing the same prize: a pair of golden *four-armed bracelets* glowing softly inside the *box*.
Lose *10* HP. Gain Relic: *Bracelets of Shiva*.
Jackie teaches you a move or two. Gain *10* Max HP.

"Elephant Kick!" *Ah Fu* laughs wildly as he slips the golden *Bracelets of Shiva* onto his wrists. *Divine power* flashes through the temple. Before *Jackie's* horrified eyes, two thick *magical arms* burst from *Ah Fu's* sides.

The *four-armed Ah Fu* howls with laughter, swings four massive fists, shatters the surrounding statues, and marches away with the *bracelets*. The terrifying *magical aftershock* slowly settles into the ruined temple air.

Facing *Ah Fu's* overwhelming assault, *Jackie* keeps shouting, "I don't want trouble!" while vaulting between pillars and vines.

Just as *Ah Fu* lunges with a "Flying Mantis," *Jackie* snatches up a *trench shovel*, smacks him across the face, and uses the momentum to kick him into a *trapdoor* deep in the temple.

"Whew... finally." *Jackie* wipes his brow, closes the *box* carefully, and seals it with one of Uncle's *good-chi charms*.

As the *bracelets* are secured, the raging *magical storm* calms. Pure, peaceful *good chi* spreads through the ruins, soothing the fatigue and pain from the road behind you.
The temple magic surges briefly, but finds no one to carry this chase forward.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HISTORY_BOOK_EVENT.title: Book of Ages
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HISTORY_BOOK_EVENT.pages:
Deep in a crack of the Spire, you find an ancient book as thick as a wall. Its pages *turn themselves*, and the ink crawls like something alive.

*Uncle*: "Ay-yah! Do not touch! This is the *Book of Ages*. What is written here becomes true!"
*Jade*: "So can we write that Shendu forgot all his bad plans?"
*Jackie*: "Jade!"
*Tohru*: "Sir, the ink has already reached Shendu's hand."

The book stops before you, waiting for you to make reality a little more convenient.
Gain all twelve Talismans. For each Talisman type you already had, gain *12* Max HP.
Gain all ten basic Masks. For each Mask type you already had, gain *5* Max HP.

As your hand touches the page, old Talismans peel away from your power.

*Uncle* waves his puffer fish and shouts, "Ay-yah! History is rewriting! For every Talisman lost, your body gets tougher!"

Talisman types reclaimed by the Book of Ages: *{Count}*.

Then twelve Talismans rise from the page, circle before you, and return to your relic bar one by one.

Ten shadow masks float from the darkness between the pages.

*Uncle* frowns. "The Shadowkhan masks are not toys! First return the ones you already stole to history!"

Mask types reclaimed by the Book of Ages: *{Count}*.

The old masks dissolve into ink, and ten new basic masks settle into your deck.

While Uncle turns to chant, you tear a page from the Book of Ages.

*Uncle*: "Ay-yah! Tearing books is bad! Tearing the Book of Ages is worse!"
*Jade*: "But this page looks awesome."

The page folds itself into a fragment and lands in your relic bar. Reality feels lightly erased, leaving room for edits.
You close the book and pretend you never saw this enormous problem.
The Book of Ages turns a page, but finds no hand to write with.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-LIFE_CHALICE_EVENT.title: Chalice of Life
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-LIFE_CHALICE_EVENT.pages:
Deep in the ruins, Team Jackie finds an ancient golden chalice glowing with a soft light.

*Jade*: "Whoa, Jackie, look! The patterns on this cup are so cool. It looks like a genie could jump out any second!"
*Jackie*: (hurriedly pulling Jade back) "Jade, don't touch it! Uncle said we are only here for archaeological records. Tohru, bring the scanner."
*Tohru*: (carefully setting down the pack) "Mr. Chan, the readings are strange... it seems to be breathing?"
*Uncle*: (smacking Tohru with a dried lizard) "Ay-yah! That is chi, ancient magical chi! Uncle's headache got better the moment he entered this room. Let Uncle check the old books... One more thing! Jackie, move your flashlight away. You are shining it in Uncle's eyes!"
Gain Relic: *Chalice of Life*. Gain Curses: *Greed* and *Shame*.

*Jackie*: "All right, photos are done and the data is recorded. We do not know what this chalice does, but leaving it here is safest. Let's go."
*Jade*: (following with a little disappointment) "Fine. I thought something exciting would happen, at least. Like a mummy waking up..."

Suddenly, warm golden light pours from the chalice, gently sinking into everyone's body as the stone door closes behind them.

*Tohru*: (rubbing his arm in surprise) "Wait... Mr. Chan, the shoulder I twisted while carrying luggage suddenly does not hurt."
*Jackie*: (moving his arms, amazed) "Me too! I feel light as a feather. All my fatigue is gone!"
*Uncle*: (adjusting his glasses) "Ay-yah! Uncle understands! This was a righteous chi trial left by ancient gods. We did not greedily take it, so we received its blessing! One more thing! Since everyone has so much energy now, Tohru, you drive on the way back!"

*Jackie*: "This place is too damp. If the chalice stays here, it may weather away. I should bring it back to the museum and let professionals protect it."

Jackie puts on gloves and carefully lifts the Chalice of Life. In an instant, its faint light flares into a solid ring around Jackie's wrist, and the temple begins to shake violently.

*Jade*: (shouting excitedly) "Cool! Jackie, I think it picked you as its owner! But... is the ceiling falling down?!"
*Jackie*: (frantically trying to shake the chalice off, only to find it stuck fast) "No, no, no! Put it back! It is stuck! Bad day, bad day, bad day! We triggered the traps!"
*Tohru*: (shielding Uncle) "Mr. Chan! The path ahead is blocked by fallen stones! And the chalice's energy is going wild. It is drawing monsters here!"
*Uncle*: (yelling angrily from behind Tohru) "Ay-yah! Uncle had not finished reading! Jackie, you fool! The Chalice of Life has a spirit, and now it is attached to you! One more thing! Since you took it, you must use its power to get us out. Use your chain kicks!"
The ancient chalice trembles softly, but finds no one to accept its trial.
